model.title: American Music Tourism Act of 2025
model.meta: Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee · Sen. Marsha Blackburn (R-TN)

summary.text: The bill would direct the National Travel and Tourism Office to actively promote tourism to U.S. music festivals, concert venues, and other music-related attractions to both domestic and international visitors. It would also expand the office's duties to include promoting international travel to American sports and recreation events, and require the office to report regularly to Congress on these efforts.
